# Highlighted spans

MD_FLAG_MARK enables ==text== and emits MD_SPAN_MARK callbacks.
Exactly two equals signs are required, with no whitespace just inside the
delimiters. Inline formatting nests normally; code and escapes stay literal.

```````````````````````````````` example
==marked==
.
<p><mark>marked</mark></p>
.
--fmark
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
==plain==
.
<p>==plain==</p>
.
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
a==b==c
.
<p>a<mark>b</mark>c</p>
.
--fmark
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
==**bold** and *italic* and _under_==
.
<p><mark><strong>bold</strong> and <em>italic</em> and <u>under</u></mark></p>
.
--fmark --funderline
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
[==linked==](https://example.com) and ==[link](https://example.com)==
.
<p><a href="https://example.com"><mark>linked</mark></a> and <mark><a href="https://example.com">link</a></mark></p>
.
--fmark
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
==`x == y`==
.
<p><mark><code>x == y</code></mark></p>
.
--fmark
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
\==literal== and `==code==`
.
<p>==literal== and <code>==code==</code></p>
.
--fmark
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
== spaced== ==spaced == ===long=== =single= ====
.
<p>== spaced== ==spaced == ===long=== =single= ====</p>
.
--fmark
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
==first
second==
.
<p><mark>first
second</mark></p>
.
--fmark
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
Heading
===
.
<h1>Heading</h1>
.
--fmark
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
==~~gone~~== and ~~==marked==~~
.
<p><mark><del>gone</del></mark> and <del><mark>marked</mark></del></p>
.
--fmark --fstrikethrough
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
前==強調==後
.
<p>前<mark>強調</mark>後</p>
.
--fmark
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
==A &amp; B==
.
<p><mark>A &amp; B</mark></p>
.
--fmark
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
==unclosed
.
<p>==unclosed</p>
.
--fmark
````````````````````````````````
